title: Finite good refinement of a Noetherian locally closed partition
statement: Let $T$ be a topological space whose closed subsets satisfy the descending-chain condition. Let $T=\coprod_{a\in A}P_a$ be a finite partition into locally closed subsets [def-weil-locally-closed-subset]. Then there is a finite partition $T=\coprod_{b\in B}Q_b$ into nonempty locally closed subsets, each $Q_b$ contained in some $P_a$, such that for all $b,c\in B$ one has $Q_b\cap\overline{Q_c}\ne\varnothing\Rightarrow Q_b\subseteq\overline{Q_c}$. Thus each $\overline{Q_c}$ is a union of members of this partition; this property is called a good stratification. If $T=\varnothing$, the empty partition is allowed.
